name: Dark Sigil heals for 15% of critical damage dealt (#3728)
contract: Dark Sigil 560535 ships two effects in Spell.dbc. Effect 0 is SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID with aura 290 SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_PCT, BasePoints 2 + DieSides 1 = 3% and radius index 12, handled natively by AuraEffect::HandleAuraModCritPct - that is the tooltip's "Increases critical strike chance of all party and raid members by 3%". Effect 1 is SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AURA with aura 354, BasePoints 14 + DieSides 1 = the 15% of "you now heal for 15% of all critical damage dealt", and TriggerSpell Bloodlord's Curse 707449, a SPELL_EFFECT_HEAL with BasePoints 0. Aura 354 has no AuraEffectHandler entry, no AuraEffect::HandleProc case and is not an isTriggerAura, so no SpellProcEntry was generated and Aura::GetProcEffectMask returned 0: the leech half healed nothing. Valanar's Vengeance 572795 is the probe - the rank a level-80 character owns, a pure SPELL_EFFECT_SCHOOL_DAMAGE with no leech of its own - and spell_crit_rating 10000 makes every hit a critical, which the scenario checks before relying on it. The caster is put in combat before the measured cast because Player::RegenerateHealth adds nothing while in combat, so a health gain can only come from the proc.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
The fixture rating guarantees a critical hit
The caster is in combat, so health regeneration is off
Control: a critical hit heals nothing without the talent
The raid critical-strike aura adds its shipped 3%
Dark Sigil heals its caster from the critical hit
